name: Snow White
description: In the depth of winter, a queen wishes for a child as white as snow, as red as blood, and with hair as black as ebony. After her mother's death, little Snow-white grows beneath the envy of a stepmother who questions her looking-glass and has her taken into the forest. Sheltered by seven dwarfs and struck down at last by a poisoned apple, she lies in a glass coffin until her bearers stumble and free the fatal morsel. At the wedding, the Queen receives the reward of her cruelty.

legal.license: Based on Little Snow-White (KHM 53) by the Brothers Grimm. Description and lore adapted from Margaret Hunt's 1884 public-domain translation.

info.name: Snow White
info.ability: Each night, choose another player and learn their team.
info.lore: A child wished for in the depth of winter, white as snow, red as blood, and black-haired as ebony. Spared by the Huntsman, she finds shelter with seven dwarfs and survives her stepmother's deceits until she wakes from the glass coffin.

cues.body: Snow White chooses another player and learns their team.
Snow White chooses another player and learns their team.

info.name: Palace Maiden
info.ability: Each night, choose two players. At dawn, learn whether they belong to the same team.
info.lore: She serves in the palace where Snow White's beauty awakens the Queen's envy. Among {{team:grimm:siervo|plural}}, messengers, and half-open doors, she learns which oaths bind every member of the court.

cues.body: Choose two players and deliver Same or Different at dawn.
Choose two players and deliver Same or Different at dawn.

presentation.title: Do they belong to the same team?

info.name: Prince
info.ability: Once per game at night, you may return a dead player to life.
info.lore: A prince from the Grimms' tales who recognizes a young woman cast aside by those around her and restores her to public life. In Snow White he receives the glass coffin and his {{team:grimm:siervo|plural}}' stumble frees the piece of apple; in Cinderella he keeps the golden slipper and rejects the false brides when he discovers their blood.

cues.body: The Prince may return a dead player to life.
If unused, the Prince may return a dead player to life.

info.name: Wicked Queen
info.ability: Each night, choose two players and give each one an Apple. Any Apple poisons them; their third Apple kills them.
info.lore: A proud stepmother who cannot bear to be surpassed in beauty. She questions her looking-glass, sends the Huntsman, and, when she learns she was deceived, assumes three disguises to attack with laces, a comb, and a poisoned apple.

cues.body: Give one Apple to each of two players.
Give one Apple to each of two players.

info.name: Magic Mirror
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and learn their team. You keep this ability if the Queen dies.
info.lore: A wonderful looking-glass that always answers truthfully when asked who is fairest in the land. Its voice tells the Queen that Snow White still lives beyond the seven mountains with the seven dwarfs.

cues.body: Choose one player and learn their team.
Choose one player and learn their team.

info.name: Forest Peddler
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and give them an Apple. You share the counter with the Queen and keep this ability if she dies.
info.lore: She is the Queen's final and most dangerous disguise: an old countrywoman who crosses the mountains with an apple divided in two, white on one side and red on the other. She eats the harmless half to overcome Snow White's mistrust.

cues.body: Give one player an Apple.
Give one player an Apple.

info.name: Wise Dwarf
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and learn their real character.
info.lore: The most prudent inhabitant of the cottage. He reads the forest tracks, listens to Snow White's tale, and recognizes behind every trinket offered at the door the stepmother's relentless hand.

cues.body: Choose one player and learn their real character.
Choose one player and learn their real character.

info.name: Grumpy Dwarf
info.ability: Once per day, when a voted execution would resolve, you may cancel it.
info.lore: He guards the cottage door beneath the mountains and distrusts every visitor. His rough temper was forged by finding Snow White stretched upon the floor too many times after she ignored the dwarfs' warnings.

info.name: Shy Dwarf
info.ability: Each night, choose a player. If they would die tonight, they do not.
info.lore: He keeps far from the door when strangers knock, yet never abandons anyone in need of shelter. From the cottage shadows he watches over Snow White while his companions work in the mountains.

cues.body: Protect one player tonight.
Protect one player tonight.

info.name: Kind Dwarf
info.ability: Each night, you may choose a player and remove one Apple.
info.lore: He shares bread, vegetables, and one of the seven beds with Snow White on condition that she tend the cottage. When poison enters their home, he patiently searches for the laces, comb, or fruit that caused the harm.

cues.body: May remove one Apple before the Queen and Peddler act.
May remove one Apple before the Queen and Peddler act.

info.name: Watchful Dwarf
info.ability: Each night, choose another player. At dawn, learn whether they used a targeted ability that night.
info.lore: He returns each evening from digging in the mountains and examines the smallest change in the cottage. His watchful eyes uncover the false peddler's visits and the signs that reveal how Snow White was attacked.

cues.body: Choose another player and report at dawn whether they made a target choice.
Choose another player and report at dawn whether they made a target choice.

presentation.title: Did they use a targeted ability tonight?

info.name: Caring Dwarf
info.ability: Each night, choose a player. They cannot become Plagued before the next dawn.
info.lore: He tends Snow White whenever the Queen strikes her down: loosening the laces that steal her breath, removing the poisoned comb, and watching over her body when no remedy can wake her.

cues.body: Protect one player from becoming Plagued.
Protect one player from becoming Plagued.

info.name: Silent Dwarf
info.ability: Once per day, make a player other than the previous day's target Plagued until the next dawn.
info.lore: He speaks through gestures and knows the worth of a barred door. In the cottage he wordlessly repeats the command to admit no stranger, imposing a silence as stern as the warnings Snow White ignored.

info.name: Hunter
info.ability: Each night, spare a player from a death caused by an evil ability. Win if you survive after sparing a {{team:grimm:pueblo}} character.
info.lore: He obeys the command to take Snow White into the forest, but cannot pierce her heart when she weeps. He lets her flee and carries the lungs and liver of a wild boar to the Queen as false proof of her death.

cues.body: Spare one player from a death caused by an evil ability.
Spare one player from a death caused by an evil ability.

info.name: Coffin Keeper
info.ability: Each night, protect a player from a death caused by an evil ability; you are Plagued during the following day. Win if you survive.
info.lore: He belongs to the dwarfs' vigil beside Snow White's uncorrupted body. He guards the transparent coffin, lets the birds and forest beasts mourn beside it, and waits for an awakening that no remedy has brought.

cues.body: Protect one player, then become Plagued and do not wake again for your ability. At dawn, receive the private notice that you are abandoned.

category.description: Optional rules that gently tilt the tale toward Good.

info.name: The Seven's Shelter
info.ability: During the first night, the Storyteller secretly protects two different players: they receive no Apples that night.
info.howToRun: Before characters act, secretly choose two different players and place Shelter on both. Ignore any Apple either would receive during the first night. Remove the markers at dawn.

reminders: Place Shelter on both until dawn.
checks: No Apples are placed on them tonight.

category.description: Optional rules that gently tilt the tale toward Evil.

info.name: The Poisoned Basket
info.ability: At the start of the first night, the Storyteller secretly places one Apple on each of two different players.
info.howToRun: Before characters act, secretly choose two different players. Give each player one Apple token: both become poisoned and begin with one Apple. Never place both Apples on the same player.
